title: Заморозить lease/fencing contract, capability model и adversarial cases
summary: Выпустить versioned P4 contract, который задаёт acquire/heartbeat/CAS, observer-vs-storage states, lease vs record clocks, capability matrix, migration unfenced complete и общий набор PHP/Dart adversarial cases.
why: Current stores finish by request+fingerprint with a crash window between effect and `complete`; F04 is confirmed. Audit SQL is not the schema (F14). `RAG:—`; внешние ограничения — `@plan/knowledge/research-P4-design-rag.json`.

exclude: Runtime implementation; PostgreSQL driver choice beyond injected SQL; outbox/saga; editing `spec/revisions/2026-08/**`; event-store/epoch APIs; final exports; public release; exactly-once claim.

rules: Contract distinguishes observer `DedupState` from storage `in_progress`/`completed`. `fail` is fenced complete-with-error. Lease token is not ALC epoch. Record cleanup never deletes `in_progress`. Unfenced `complete(request)` is unsupported after cutover; dual unfenced+fenced production complete is forbidden. Frozen `2026-08` remains byte-identical. Exactly-once tool effect is a non-guarantee. Numeric bounds match `@plan/knowledge/research-P4-design.json`.
guidance: Manifest `schema_version=idempotency-lease-cases/v1` has unique case IDs, phase (`acquire|heartbeat|complete|fail|cleanup|capability`), expected semantic code/category, PHP/Dart applicability and named seam. Include at least: 50-way acquire one winner; in-flight immediate; fingerprint reuse; takeover after expiry; stale complete/fail/heartbeat lost-lease; completed error replay; in-progress survives record TTL; completed expiry becomes new; high-risk unknown deny-before-insert; at-most-once takeover stores ambiguous; native_key passes the same key. Migration inventory names every `IdempotencyStore`/`complete(` consumer and one P4/P6/P7 disposition.
